import json
import primitive_api as p

def last():
    return p.observe_world().get("lastActionMessage", "")[:140]

def soils_near():
    near = p.list_nearby_objects()
    objs = near.get("objects", near) if isinstance(near, dict) else near
    out = []
    for k, v in objs.items():
        if k == "same_location":
            continue
        for o in v:
            if o.get("name") == "soil":
                out.append(o)
    out.sort(key=lambda o: o.get("distance", 99))
    return out

def axis(d):
    for c in ("south", "north", "east", "west"):
        if c in d:
            return c
    return None

def dig_site(loc):
    p.teleport_to_location(loc)
    print("== ", loc, "loc", p.observe_world().get("agentLocation"))
    for _ in range(8):
        ss = soils_near()
        if not ss:
            print("no soil nearby"); return
        t = ss[0]
        d = axis(t["direction"])
        if t["distance"] <= 1:
            p.rotate_direction(d)
            break
        p.rotate_direction(d)
        p.move_direction(d)
    ss = soils_near()
    if not ss:
        print("lost soil"); return
    t = ss[0]
    p.rotate_direction(axis(t["direction"]))
    p.use_object(4766, t["uuid"])
    print("dig:", last())
    acc = p.list_accessible_objects()
    arts = [o for o in acc if o.get("name") == "ancient artifact"]
    print("arts:", [(o["uuid"], o.get("description")) for o in arts])
    for a in arts:
        p.use_object(60834, a["uuid"])
        print("date:", last())
    print("VERIFY", json.dumps(p.check_success(), default=str))
